title: jint truncates i64->i32 silently: a lead/pct JSON value >= 2^32 wraps to a valid small positive and bypasses the r2 fail-fast
detail: The W3 fix validates the i32 AFTER jint's unchecked i64->i32 wrap. A value 2^32+600 becomes 600 and passes, so a corrupt balance.json silently falsifies the reaction-window display instead of failing load.
recommended_fix: Parse leads/pcts from the raw json.Integer (i64) and reject values outside i32 range before the cast, or use jint_strict with an explicit range check.
